user.title: Choose your Tuya Local vacuum
user.description: Select a vacuum and its writable command_trans text entity (DP15 on the SL60D). Both must be enabled and belong to the same Tuya Local device. No commands will be sent. Room cleaning requires the Tuya sweeper 0x14/0x15 protocol; Tuya Local support alone does not establish compatibility. After setup, open Configure to learn rooms.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect source entities
reconfigure.description: Changing either source clears learned rooms and invalidates old area mappings. Entity renames are handled automatically. Select the writable command_trans text entity on the vacuum's device.

error.invalid_sources: Choose enabled Tuya Local vacuum and text entities on the same device.
error.already_configured: This vacuum already has a room-cleaning companion.

abort.already_configured: This vacuum already has a room-cleaning companion.

menu_options.learn: Learn a room from Smart Life
menu_options.manual: Enter an ID or paste a report

learn.title: Learn one room
learn.description: Enter a room name. On the next screen, start that room alone in Smart Life. This will physically start the robot through Smart Life; this integration only listens. You control stopping or docking it. A report already present before listening is not accepted.

learn_failed.title: No room saved
learn_failed.description: {reason} You can try again or paste a known report. Repeated cached reports cannot prove a new selection.

menu_options.manual: Enter an ID or paste a report

manual.title: Add a known room
manual.description: Enter a decimal room ID (0–255) or paste a single-room 0x15 base64 report. A numeric ID requires explicit protocol confirmation. IDs are specific to the current robot map; never copy another user's assignments. No command is sent.

data.name: Room name
data.confirm_protocol: I have verified this device uses the Tuya sweeper 0x14/0x15 room protocol

confirm.title: Confirm learned room
confirm.description: Save a name for room ID {room}. Existing name: {previous}. Saving replaces the name if this ID already exists. This does not test cleaning. Then map the learned room to a Home Assistant area in the companion vacuum's entity settings.

delete.title: Delete a learned room
delete.description: Submitting removes this room. Update the companion vacuum's area mapping afterward.

reset.title: Reset the learned map?
reset.description: Submitting removes ALL learned rooms and invalidates old area mappings. Do this whenever Smart Life changes the map or room numbering. Relearn rooms and map them to HA areas again before cleaning.

progress.listen: Now start only {name} in Smart Life. Waiting up to two minutes for a changed single-room report. If the report stays identical, cancel and use manual entry. The integration sends no commands.

error.duplicate_name: Another room already uses this name.
error.invalid_report: Enter a valid 0x15 room report with a correct length and checksum.
error.multiple_rooms: This report contains multiple rooms. Select exactly one room in Smart Life.
error.invalid_room: Room IDs must be integers from 0 to 255.
error.confirm_protocol: Confirm protocol compatibility before saving a numeric room ID.
error.source_unavailable: Load the integration and make the command text entity available before learning.

abort.no_rooms: There are no learned rooms yet.
abort.learning_cancelled: Learning was cancelled because the source changed or the integration unloaded.

learning_busy.message: Room learning is active. Finish or cancel it before starting room cleaning.

invalid_sources.message: The configured Tuya Local source entities are missing, disabled, or no longer on the same device. Restore them or reconfigure this integration.

vacuum_unavailable.message: The Tuya Local vacuum is unavailable or has no known state. Check its connection and wait for it to become available.

command_unavailable.message: The Tuya Local command text entity is unavailable or has not loaded. Check its connection and wait for it to become available.

payload_too_long.message: The room command exceeds the command text entity's maximum length. Select fewer rooms.

invalid_selection.message: Select known rooms and confirm protocol compatibility. If the map changed, relearn rooms and update the native area mapping.

command_failed.message: Tuya Local could not confirm the service call. Check the robot before retrying; the command may already have been accepted.

missing_sources.title: Room-cleaning source entities need attention
missing_sources.description: A configured Tuya Local vacuum or command text entity is missing, disabled, or no longer belongs to the same device. Restore the original entities or use Reconfigure. Replacing sources clears learned rooms.
